## What changed?

Describe the problem and the change. Link a related issue when there is one.

## How was it checked?

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` reports no files
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes

## Public API and behavior

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] I updated README and Go documentation for public API changes, or no update is needed.
- [ ] I described compatibility impact and any new dependency, or neither applies.
- [ ] Examples, logs, and fixtures contain no API keys, webhook secrets, or real customer data.

See the [contribution guide](https://github.com/dotmarn/mailcheckr-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [security policy](https://github.com/dotmarn/mailcheckr-go/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
